name: space-arena

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json

//allowScripts: Keys are version-pinned, so every upgrade of one of these packages re-surfaces the npm-11 allow-scripts warning until its entry is bumped — that is deliberate (re-approval should be a conscious step). esbuild matters at PRODUCTION runtime since 6.3: the Docker image runs the server via tsx, and esbuild's install script is its fallback for resolving the platform binary when the optionalDependencies path fails.
